reviewedBy: Codex root: maintained-controller preservation and native result-freshness review
reason: Ghana PAYE UI invalidates stale result eligibility on input edits and guards delayed chart, rate-bar and AI presentation completions. Valid calculations enable the existing explicit local scenario-save action without adding automatic history or cloud writes. Relief checkboxes have descriptive accessible names, keyboard focus and 44px minimum tap targets; the guide grid can shrink on narrow screens. Manual result scrolling respects reduced motion and automatic salary recalculation does not scroll. The existing gh_paye_calculate event now records tool, country and mode metadata instead of raw salary/effective-rate fields. Inline calculation constants/functions through reverseCalc remain byte-identical to the integration baseline; PDF construction, engine sources and their 25 existing assertions, consent owner, shared guards and scenario-sync owner are unchanged. Refresh only route-gh-paye maintained-artifact fingerprint and its derived protected references. This records a controller/UI and analytics-privacy change without accepting statutory changes, refreshed source dates, changed golden outcomes or future automatic formula acceptance.
